use default
use System.Math

use RealSet = (double) -> bool

open_range(low: double, high: double) -> RealSet =>
    value => low < value /\ value < high

closed_range(low: double, high: double) -> RealSet =>
    value => low <= value /\ value <= high

open_closed(low: double, high: double) -> RealSet =>
    value => low < value /\ value <= high

closed_open(low: double, high: double) -> RealSet =>
    value => low <= value /\ value < high

joined(left: RealSet, right: RealSet) -> RealSet =>
    value => left(value) \/ right(value)

shared(left: RealSet, right: RealSet) -> RealSet =>
    value => left(value) /\ right(value)

without(left: RealSet, right: RealSet) -> RealSet =>
    value => left(value) /\ !right(value)

samples(low: double, high: double, steps: int) -> Pipe[double] =>
    (0::steps)
        |> map(step =>
            low + (high - low) * cast double(step) / cast double(steps))

is_empty(set: RealSet, low: double, high: double, steps: int) -> bool =>
    samples(low, high, steps) |> all(value => !set(value))

extent(set: RealSet, low: double, high: double, steps: int) -> double =>
    let inside = samples(low, high, steps) |> filter(set) |> count() in
    (high - low) * cast double(inside) / cast double(steps)

let examples =
    [(name = "(0,1] u [0,2)",
      set = joined(open_closed(0.0D, 1.0D), closed_open(0.0D, 2.0D))),
     (name = "[0,2) n (1,2]",
      set = shared(closed_open(0.0D, 2.0D), open_closed(1.0D, 2.0D))),
     (name = "[0,3) - (0,1)",
      set = without(closed_open(0.0D, 3.0D), open_range(0.0D, 1.0D))),
     (name = "[0,3) - [0,1]",
      set = without(closed_open(0.0D, 3.0D), closed_range(0.0D, 1.0D)))]

write_line("membership:")

examples |> each(example => (
    let answers =
        [0.0D, 1.0D, 2.0D]
            |> map(value => "{value:F0}: {example.set(value),-5}")
            |> join(" ")

    write_line("  {example.name}   {answers.trim_end()}")
))

write_line()
write_line("emptiness over [0,2]:")

let probes =
    [(name = "[1,1]", set = closed_range(1.0D, 1.0D)),
     (name = "(1,1)", set = open_range(1.0D, 1.0D)),
     (name = "(0,0]", set = open_closed(0.0D, 0.0D))]

probes |> each(probe =>
    write_line("  {probe.name} is empty: "
               "{is_empty(probe.set, 0.0D, 2.0D, 100_000)}"))

let ripples: RealSet =
    value =>
        0.0D < value /\ value < 10.0D /\
            Math.abs(Math.sin(Math.pi * value * value)) > 0.5D

let waves: RealSet =
    value =>
        0.0D < value /\ value < 10.0D /\
            Math.abs(Math.sin(Math.pi * value)) > 0.5D

write_line()
write_line("length of A - B over (0,10): "
           "{extent(without(ripples, waves), 0.0D, 10.0D, 1_000_000):F3}")
